source_identity.join_status: Exact sealed ACTIVE_WAVE row plus explicit FE-306 heading; no label/fuzzy join used.

candidate: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction / Agent State Graph
primary_claims_audited: Across twelve public agent-trace datasets, compact finite-state models replay held-out traces with >=0.997 fitness while raw replay fitness alone is near chance for failure prediction.
State/transition-derived features materially improve failure prediction, with reported AUROC up to 0.941 and an ATBench repeated-CV mean 0.864 +/- 0.024.
On SWE-agent, an online structural monitor is reported to fire around 32% of trace completion at 85.9% precision and 95.5% recall.
For tau2-bench retail next-action prediction, a compact local projection is reported at 65.1% top-1 versus 52.2% for the full FSM and 49.2% for a larger multi-step graph context.

published_primary.paper: Seonglae Cho et al., Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction, arXiv:2608.23670, submitted 2026-08-24
published_primary.assessment: The author project publicly exposes the twelve-dataset table, failure-prediction/monitor metrics and workflow-memory comparison values matching the sealed worker extraction. This is strong primary-study reporting but not independent recomputation.

official_artifacts.space_assessment: The accessible Space is a static Astro/nginx interactive research article. Its embedded HTML hard-codes reported summary rows, including failure-prediction values; it is a presentation artifact, not a raw experiment runner or result-reconstruction pipeline.
official_artifacts.linked_github_status_at_audit: 404 / not resolvable through both public web traversal and GitHub repository lookup. A search of the author's accessible public repositories did not recover an equivalent repository under that name.
official_artifacts.assessment: Official presentation support is strong, but official executable research-artifact support is currently incomplete.

independent_replication.assessment: No protocol-matched third-party reproduction with released raw held-out predictions, trace splits, monitor decisions or next-action outputs was found in this audit. Secondary reproduction trackers likewise did not identify a maintained verified implementation; this is supporting absence evidence, not proof that none exists.

algorithm_specification_audit.finding: The public article simultaneously describes structural state merging as Myhill-Nerode equivalence on the observed prefix language and describes the resulting object as a directly-follows automaton with one state per activity. The twelve-dataset state-count table is exactly actions+1 in every listed row, which is consistent with the directly-follows representation.
algorithm_specification_audit.counterexample: For observed traces abx and cby, the prefix states after ab and cb share last activity b but have different right-languages {x} and {y}; they are not Myhill-Nerode equivalent. Merging solely by last activity unions x/y outgoing transitions and over-accepts aby and cbx.
algorithm_specification_audit.scope: This does not refute the reported positive-trace replay fitness: an over-accepting directly-follows automaton can still replay every observed/held-out positive trace. It does mean the public prose is insufficient to identify a unique Myhill-Nerode-minimal construction without the executable implementation or author clarification.
algorithm_specification_audit.reproducibility_impact: Algorithm-specification reproducibility is downgraded because two non-equivalent constructions are described as if they were the same.

reconstruction_status.reported_table_values: A-: preserved in official author/project presentation artifacts.
reconstruction_status.raw_numerical_recomputation: C: raw held-out predictions, train/test trace memberships, transition-feature matrices, monitor trigger rows and workflow-memory model outputs were not recovered.
reconstruction_status.official_executable_pipeline: C: the linked code repository was unavailable and the accessible Hugging Face Space is static presentation code.
reconstruction_status.algorithm_specification: B-: enough public description to understand the intended family, but the directly-follows versus Myhill-Nerode statements are not generally equivalent.

safe_conclusion: FE-306's narrow lesson remains supported as primary-study evidence: near-perfect positive-trace replay is not by itself evidence of failure-prediction utility, and the reported compact local workflow projection outperforms full-graph context on the tested tau2 retail setup. Neither result is independently reproduced here. The public artifact state does not currently support protocol-matched exact replay, and the public algorithm prose contains a material ambiguity between a one-state-per-activity directly-follows automaton and a Myhill-Nerode-minimal DFA.
scope_limits: Do not generalize the reported AUROC/precision/recall or next-action values beyond the paper's twelve datasets, extraction function, models and evaluated conditions.
Do not infer that replay fitness is useless for all anomaly detection; the audited claim is that raw replay fitness alone was near-chance in the reported failure-prediction setups.
Do not infer that full workflow context is always harmful; the 52.2/49.2/65.1 comparison is specific to the tested tau2-bench retail prompting/materialization conditions.
Do not call the public construction a unique Myhill-Nerode-minimal DFA until executable source or an author clarification resolves the specification ambiguity.
reopen_conditions: The linked official GitHub implementation becomes publicly resolvable or a source-matched replacement is released.
Raw trace split manifests, per-example failure scores/predictions, online monitor decisions or tau2 next-action outputs are released so headline values can be recomputed.
A protocol-matched independent reproduction or failure report is released.
The authors clarify or code-resolve the directly-follows versus Myhill-Nerode construction and publish a version-pinned executable artifact.
